programme.desc: A lace bra and knicker set tests the sewers before they turn thermals into daywear. They must then fit a pair of luxury pyjamas to their male models. One sewers wins Garment of the Week, and another is asked to leave the Sewing Room

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The quarter finalists go back to the 1930s to take women’s sailor trousers. They also turn men’s shirts into 1930s women’s blouses and fit glamorous bias-cut evening gowns reminiscent of outfits worn by Katherine Hepburn and Bette Davis.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes the four semi-finalists into the Sewing Room to celebrate the influences of Japanese design and sewing. The Sewers follow the patterns for a kimono inspired dress, mend old denim using Japanese techniques and create an outfit using folding and pleating

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the final, and the sewers take on a trio of party themed challenges. They start with the pattern for Esme’s iconic Amorphous dress, use old scraps to make a party outfit and fit red-carpet-worthy jumpsuits. The judges have the difficult task of deciding who will be crowed by Britain’s best sewer

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes 12 new sewers to the Sewing Bee. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young test the sewers with ‘Classics with a Twist’. The sewers make a top with a twist, transform the office uniform into a new look to reflect their style and create a dress that has cut out details to fit their models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s not exactly a holiday for the sewers, as judges Patrick and Esme task them with creating garments based around a travel wardrobe. They’re asked to create a rucksack and a swimsuit and to transform windbreakers. Who will make a splash, and who will take a nose dive and leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The ten remaining sewers celebrate clothes from west Africa. Guest judge Nigerian fashion designer Banke Kuku joins Esme and Patrick this week. Who will impress all three judges and win Garment of the Week, and who will become the third sewer to leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Taking on the fashion industry, the second most polluting industry in the world, it’s Reduce, Reuse and Recycle week. The sewers attempt a zero waste pattern for a pair of trousers, transform several bags in to a garment and source second hand crochet blankets to create new outfits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Art week as the remaining sewers tackle three challenges inspired by the world of art. The sewers make a skirt inspired by the modernist movement, transform canvases into dresses, and draw on artists’ dreams to create fantastical outfits for a mind bending catwalk.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Kids week in the sewing room, and Sara Pascoe invites the seven remaining sewers to make a child’s dragon dressing gown. In the transformation challenge, the sewers personalise denim jackets using hand-me-downs. Finally mini models have fancy dress outfits created ready for the party.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Its week 7 and we’re going back to the 90s with cargo pants, 90s icon fancy dress and body skimming supermodel dresses. Who will make it into the quarter final, and who will take a tumble on the catwalk and leave the sewing room?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 8, and the remaining sewers celebrate fashion icons with little black dresses, a shower curtain transformation and smoking jackets. Who will secure icon status and win Garment of the Week, and who will be a fashion fail?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the semi-final, and this week it’s three utilitarian clothing; the trench coat, housework garments and boiler suits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the final of The Great British Sewing Bee, and the sewers face three challenges including a Victoriana dress, fabulous men’s outfits and a two-in-one dress. Past contestants return for a reunion, while the judges decide who will be crowned this year’s best amateur sewer.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: To kick things off the teams must rely on their patisserie instincts, knowledge and teamwork to create 36 individual tarte aux fraise and one chocolate amenity in just three and a half hours. The second, challenges the teams to a music themed Trompe L’oeil showpiece with hidden Pecan Pies

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The teams must turn all their patisserie experience to create 24 identical reimagined custard tarts and 24 cotton cheesecakes. In their second challenge the teams will have five hours to turn the spectacle of Carnival into showpiece structures adorned with exotic flavoured desserts.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In their first challenge, the teams must turn their hand to viennoiserie as they are tasked to make 18 cross laminated pain suisse and 24 savoury brioche doughnuts. For their showpiece challenge, the teams produce choux showpieces featuring 160 individual choux buns inspired by the theme, Circus

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The judges have a secret challenge in store for the teams, the coffee éclair, with no recipe and just three and a half hours to complete the task. In their second challenge, the teams will have five hours to create a Trompe L’oeil showpiece sculpture inspired by everyday household objects.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Kiell Smith-Bynoe welcomes the 12 sewers as we kick off the tenth series. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young set the challenges. The Pattern challenge is a denim A-line midiskirt, they’re asked to transform t-shirts and the made to measure is to create a casual day dress to fit their models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s sports week in the sewing room. In the first challenge, the sewers are presented with a pattern for a half zip fleece, then transform a whole new outfit from cricket whites and protection. Finally, the sewers make an outfit for a specific sport fit for an international event.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 3 of the Sewing Bee, and the sewers face three challenges inspired by travel. They are asked to create summer blouses from tablecloths, nautical bags and French Riviera outfits. Who will make a fashion faux pas and who will turn heads with some je ne sais quoi?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Kiell Smith-Bynoe welcomes back Reduce Reuse Recycle week. First, the sewers attempt a quilted bag using scraps. In the transformation challenge the sewers use textile waste to create a new item. Finally, the sewers take wedding dressed and repurpose them into an outfit for a party.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Kiell Smith-Bynoe and judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young are joined by a special guest judge, Priya Khanchandani. This week the sewers celebrate fashion and textile from India. They create Nehru jackets, transform calico and Madras fabrics into an outift, and create garments inspired by saris.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Children’s Week. The remaining sewers follow the pattern for a child’s sequined bomber jacket and transform beach towels into new animal themed fancy dress outfits. Finally, the sewers use inspiration from a childhood photo to create new outfits for their mini models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: This week the sewers must face three lingerie challenges. It’s time as they’re given a pattern for a pyjama blouse. The sewers take shapewear and lace to create new outfits in the transformation challenge. Finally. The sewers tackle boning and make bustier dresses in the made to measure.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The remaining sewers celebrate divas past and present. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young use Tina Turner’s iconic fringed dress as inspiration for the pattern challenge. There is an animal print transformation and in the made to measure, the sewers create a stage outfit for their favourite diva

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the semi final and three challenges inspired by design icons . Firstly, the sewers recreate a Christobal Balenciaga dress. Next. taking the lead from Paul Gaultier, neck ties are transformed to create new garments. Finally, the sewers are to create a garment inspired by Coco Chanel.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Patrick Grant and Esme Young kick the final off by challenging the sewers to make opera gloves. In the transformation challenge they turn party paraphernalia, into a complete party outfit. Finally, the sewers create a full outfit by draping their models. Who will be crowned the winner?

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: In the opening episode, Mary Berry shows us how to host a traditional tea party without any fuss with a clever trick for making sandwiches in advance. And her granddaughters help her to make orange butterfly cakes. Mary also visits Britain’s only tea plantation in Cornwall to find out how tea is grown

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: Mary shows us how to cook dishes to impress guests at a dinner party. These include two delicious canapés, a salmon and asparagus starter, a main course of guinea fowl and a decadent chocolate tart for pudding. Mary even has a trick for cooking steak ahead of time which guarantees perfect results.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: Mary is back in her kitchen to cook her favourite meal, Sunday Lunch for three generations of her family. The star of the show is slow roast shoulder of lamb with rosemary and paprika rub, served with potato and fennel gratin. For pudding Mary serves plum tarte tatin and a delicious fruit salad.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: This time Mary Berry is cooking dishes for a family celebration. With recipes for beef and mushroom stew with mustard mash, salmon en croûte with a foolproof salad, and chocolate and orange panna cotta. Mary’s meringue tranche with berries and cream is guaranteed to impress your friends and family

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: Mary’s Mediterranean platter of houmous, bread sticks, roasted vegetables and a tomato and mozzarella salad is perfect food for sharing. For hungry guests Mary offers lamb dhansak and a a pasta dish that takes just 15 minutes to make.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: In this final episode Mary shows us recipes for a summer party. Salmon fillets with herb sauce, ham with homemade chutney and fillet of beef with garlic and mustard cream alongside which she serves fiery red rice, and broad bean and little gem salads and to finish off Mary’s summer pudding.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Renowned baking writer Mary Berry and professional baker Paul Hollywood explore the history of the Great British wedding cake, looking at its change from the earliest Tudor creation and the extravagant Victorian period to wartime Britain, the affluent eighties and present day

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The ten bakers tackle three challenges as their cake making ability is tested. They start with their signature bake - the cake they love that says something about them. Next, is the technical challenge - a blind recipe for Victoria sandwich. Finally, they tackle a chocolate showstopper.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: As the bakers battle it out over biscuits, scones and petit fours, Mel and Sue find out how the digestive became Britain's favourite biscuit, ask what's so Scottish about shortbread and discover why Sir Ranulph Fiennes has the world's most expensive biscuit.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's week three and the six remaining bakers are making bread in Kent. And as they battle it out to produce the perfect loaf, Mel and Sue will be tasting Britain's earliest bread roll, finding out what happened to break during the Industrial Revolution and relating the hidden history of the sandwich

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's week four and the remaining five bakers travel to Bakewell in Derbyshire. They must reinvent a British classic - the pudding. There are sticky toffee puddings, peach and blueberry 'boy bait', rhubarb and orange betty and a cherry queen of puddings. Can the bakers rise to the occasion?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's the penultimate round and the bakers are in the Cornish village of Mousehole, to get to grips with the most difficult of all baking skills - pastry. They make their own version of hearty British pies, produce pastry canapes, and take a crash-course in crimping for this week's surprise bake.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The search for Britain’s best pastry chef races on with hosts Ellie Taylor and Liam Charles. The five remaining teams undertake two even tougher challenges to create 4 charlotte a la russe, and Haute Couture inspired Showpieces with aperitif flavoured desserts in just five hours

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining 4 teams are fighting it out under the sharp gaze from patisserie experts Benoit Blin and Cherish Finden. The teams must deliver 18 savoury croissants and 24 perfectly filled maritozzi, and tap into their playful side as they produce towerling choux and nougatine showpieces.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The competition is about to get even tougher for the teams as the search for Britain’s best pastry chefs continues into the Final Six. The best three teams from each set of heats come together in this chocolate fuelled episode as they continue in their pursuit to reach the final.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: It’s the quarter finals, and the five remaining teams create a plated dessert for each of the judges, which celebrates caramel. For their second challenge, the teams will have 5 hours to create a display of frozen lollipops, within a delicate sugar sculpture inspired by the theme Winter Wonderland.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's the grand final and the three surviving contestants face their biggest challenge yet - baking for an afternoon tea party. to be crowned the victor they need to bring together their skills making cakes, bread and pastry. Mel and Sue can only present the trophy to one. Wil will it be?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Catching up with the bakers to hear the highs and lows of their journey, we learn where they are now and how The Great British Baking Show changed their lives. With contributions from judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, who give their own accounts and memories from the series.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The twelve amateur bakers are challenged to make 24 beautifully flavoured and decorated cupcakes, to make a coffee and walnut Battenberg cake from one of Mary Berry’s recipes and finally they have to make and bake a tiered showstopper cake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Mel Giedroyc and Sye Perkins present the second round, where the bakers pastry skills are tested as they tackle tarts.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The third round of the competition continues in the search for Britain’s best amateur baker. Ten bakers remain and this week it is Paul’s watch – Bread. Their skills are put to the test in the freeform flavoured loaf signature, Focaccia technical and break basket display showstopper.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It is half way through the search for Britain’s best amateur baker. This week the bakers take on biscuits and these bite-sized, delicate delights prove too much for some. Who will crumble when it comes to judging and whose ginger nuts are too hot to handle?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The fifth round of The Great British Baking Show hosted by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins continues in the search for Britain’s best amateur baker. This week everyone is out to avoid the dreaded soggy bottom as the seven remaining bakers face pies . Who will be named Star Baker and who will leave?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: This week the remaining five have to impress with their dessert skills. Starting with the Signature Bake the judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood are expecting to see and taste baked cheesecakes that reach their high expectations. Who will have what it takes to book a place in next week’s semi final.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: After weeks of gruelling challenges the 4 remaining bakers; Holly, Janet, Jo and Mary-Anne have to excel in every challenge to prove they are worth a place in the final. As usual all challenges set and judged by acclaimed master baker Paul Hollywood and legendary cookery writer and baker Mary Berry

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The Great British Baking Show has reached the Grand Final. After 7 gruelling weeks the three finalists; Holly, Jo and Mary-Anne face their biggest challenge yet - baking for The Great British Baking Show's street party. Only one can be crowned Britain’s Best Amateur Baker and take home the trophy

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Catch up with the bakers from series two of The Great British Baking Show. What was it really like to compete in the tent, be judged by Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, and comforted by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins? And how has their shared love of baking and appearing on the series changed their lives?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The first episode is all about cake. To keep hold of their place in the Baking Show tent the bakers attempt to produce a showstopping cake revealing a hidden design when it is sliced in to. But who will impress the judges and become Star Baker and who will be the first to leave The Great British Baking Show?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: From the off the atmosphere in the Baking Show tent is charged as 11 bakers attempt to make flatbreads, 8 strand plaited loaf and 12 sweet and 12 savoury bagels in he showstopper challenge. But who will impress and be named Star Baker and who will fail to make the grade and have to leave.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Things are hotting up in the Baking show tent in Ep 3 as the remaining 10 bakers do their best to wow Paul and Mary with unusual flavour combinations for their tartes tartin. Produce a treacle tart technical and a showstopping tart. Who will win Star Baker and whose time in the tent has come to an end.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: This week the bakers get their just dessert as they face 3 challenges all designed for a sweet tooth. Starting off with a tempting array of decadently rich tortes, the bakers then face the technical challenge, crème caramel and finish off with a mighty showstopping layered meringue.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The bakers turn their attention to pies and master a perfect wellington and hand raised pies. With several bakers in the danger zone, everything rests on the showstopper challenge - American pies. Who will be this week's star-spangled baker and who will be leaving the baking tent?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The bakers go all out to impress Mary and Paul with two types of delicious sponge puddings. The technical challenge sees them face a Queen Of Pudding, a recipe direct from the archives of the Queen of Bakes, Mary Berry. And finally a Showstopping strudel that stretches the bakers to their limit

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Last week, after an accident with a food processor there are still 7 bakers left, but tonight 2 must go. This week is sweet dough recipes, including a signature regional bun challenge, a surprise technical jam doughnut recipe and a showstopping enriched dough loaf fit for a celebration

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It’s the biscuit based quarter final, and Paul and Mary are testing the bakers as they attempt to deliver a huge batch of perfectly baked crispbreads in the signature. The bakers have very little instructions to produce tempered chocolate tea cakes and build a showstopper from biscuits.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The semi-final and if the four remaining teams thought it had been tough so far then they are going to need to brace themselves for what’s in store. World renowned sugar expert and guest judge Nicolas Houchet, Executive Pastry Chef at the iconic 5-star hotel, The Savoy, will set their first challenge.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The search for Britain’s best pastry chefs reaches its conclusion in the grand finale. The remaining three teams pour all their patisserie passion and expertise into two epic final challenges, where nothing less than brilliance will be good enough at this stage of the competition.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: Battling it out in the first heat are three young chefs from a five star hotel: a team which invents desserts for a leading supermarket: and a trio of chefs who work in secret restaurants hidden away in the City of London

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge welcomes three more teams of expert chefs to the competition. In the second heat of this incredible bake off, a team from the British Armed Forces meet the only all-women team in the competition and a team from a world-famous London hotel

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: There are only four bakers left vying for a place in the much sought after final of the Great British Baking show. The weight of the occasion is getting to the most unflappable of the bakers as they frantically work against the clock to deliver petits fours to Paul and Mary’s exacting standards.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: After weeks of pastries, cakes and bread, 3 Bakers have made it to the final. But they face the most demanding of challenges yet as every aspect of their baking skill is scrutinised. After 2 days of baking, whowill claim the title, winner of The Great British Baking show?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Catch up with the bakers from series three of The Great British Baking Show. What was it really like to compete in the tent, be judged by Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, and comforted by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins? And how has their shared love of baking and appearing on the series changed their lives?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: With a range of baking styles and personalities, the tent is packed with the best amateur bakers from around the country. The judges test the bakers skills with a sandwich cake challenge, ask them to produce an Angel Food Cake with the bare bones of a recipe and create a chocolate Showstopper.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Longevity Gene"
programme.desc: Studying the genes and lifestyles of centenarians. The results may offer answers to living longer and fighting diseases.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Angkor Wat"
programme.desc: Temples, designed to honor the Gods, have been at the heart of cities since the earliest times

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Power Of Water"
programme.desc: Without water, civilization is simply not possible. Romans took control of their water supplies very, very seriously.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "History’s Greatest Ships"
programme.desc: As far back as the Bronze Age, humans were building ships capable of crossing oceans and trading between continents.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Stone Age Secrets"
programme.desc: Even before the start of recorded history, ancient engineers across the World were erecting giant monuments. What was their purpose?

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Threatened Places"
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit a few examples of threatened places.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Hidden Nature"
programme.desc: In this episode, we see a few hidden parts of nature.

programme.desc: In this episode, we visit a few remote areas to see how research and restoration is conducted.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Science Communicators"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll meet a few different science communicators

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Just-Terry-Fied"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will be test 2 scenes from Justified where, Terry, aka Raylan Givins finds himself in a bathtub and a dead body lying over top of him.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Reindeer Game"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test a scene from Reindeer Games when Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron get trapped under a frozen lake, and they escape by shooting 3 shots with a 12-gauge shot gun underwater to blast a hole in the ice to escape.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Ex-Men The Origins of Terry"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test a famous scene from X-men. They are attempting to see if you can split a bullet with a Katana sword

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Pay Terry Back"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test 2 scenes from Mel Gibson’s film Payback. Mel's character is in the back of a taxi when 4 bad guys pull up next to him in an SUV, they open fire and Mel uses a bad guy in the cab as a shield.

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Smarts"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. What’s the name of the largest fault line in California? How does the Venus Flytrap catch bugs? Is the far side of the moon always dark?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Quiz"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. How long can a person exist without water? How fast is the International Space Station travelling through space? What exactly are DNA Forensics?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci IQ"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. On average, how deep are our oceans? What was the largest earthquake ever measured on the Richter scale? What is an apex predator?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci World"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. What’s the hairiest animal on the planet? What is the most common cause of the waves in the ocean? Why does the surface of Mars look red?

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Believe It Or Not"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler presents amazing science stunts that your friends will not believe – but they’re real! – from pre-sliced bananas to the way to crush raw eggs without turning them to mushy egg soup.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Cold War In Central America"
programme.desc: In the 1980s, El Salvador and Nicaragua were fighting vicious civil wars that claimed killed at least 100,000, saw 8000 people disappear, and left hundreds of thousands displaced. Still spearheading a global fight against communism, the US engaged.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Desert War In Mali"
programme.desc: It is a deadly war in the desert, one we know barely anything about. Once the heart of the golden Mali Empire, home to the richest man of the 14th century, the northern town of Timbuktu has become the victim of political instability and terror.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Coups Detat"
programme.desc: An uncompromising show of power, the military coup is an age-old method to violently and often secretly topple governments and take control by force. This episode goes behind the scenes of some of the greatest coups in recent history.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "The Gaza Offensive"
programme.desc: A mixture of political frustration and violent challenges led to the Gaza Offensive in 2014. As so many times over the past 13 years, Israeli soldiers launched brutally into the streets of Gaza, leaving destruction and death in their wake.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programme.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hitler's Last Secret"
programme.desc: Thanks to secret, recently discovered microfilm, Hitler's last secret is revealed: a sprawling underground headquarters at Książ Castle.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Mussolini's Underground Refuge"
programme.desc: 50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Luxurious technology"
programme.desc: Discover the use of technology in sports car design, the computer models that help manufacturers develop technology and features of the latest sports car models.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Ayurveda Nepal"
programme.desc: Discover how the traditional Ayurveda system works in a resort in Nepal with different activities, courses and food.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Global Health Italy"
programme.desc: Get a glimpse of lifestyle and the impact of eating traditional, organic and regional food on the health of Italians.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Tom Sietas"
programme.desc: Thom travels to the UK to track down Aquaman Tom Sietas, who can hold his breath submerged for a death defying 22 minutes.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Anthony Kelly"
programme.desc: Thom’s in the UK to track down Anthony Kelly; a man whose world record breaking reflexes are rumoured to be superhuman.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "George Aldrich"
programme.desc: Thom meets a man with a superhuman sense of smell; George Aldrich is Nasa’s Chief Sniffer; employed to detect problems before they become a hazard in space.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Capturing Woodstock"
programme.desc: Few films have had a bigger impact on the American psyche than "Woodstock". Producer Dale Bell reeveals what it took to create the revolutionary documentary that captured the definig moment of 1960s counterculture.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Music"
programme.desc: Dr Jack is going to sing with a choir like no other. Many of the members cannot talk, but they can sing!

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Empathy"
programme.desc: We meet an individual who has an extraordinary neurological condition, mirror touch synaesthesia, allows them to feel the exact sensation or emotion of another.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Gut"
programme.desc: Jack meets a poker player who has won millions in high stakes international tournaments using his gut instincts.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Twins"
programme.desc: Dr Jack Lewis is on a mission to understand why identical twins are such an asset to science from development in the womb onwards.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Design"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell finds out what it takes to design and build the next generation of rollercoasters.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Speed"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard some of the world’s fastest theme park rides and learns what it takes to build them.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Falling"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell discovers how our fear of falling is exploited by some of the world’s top theme park rides.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Height"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard four spectacular rollercoasters in Europe and America that exploit our fear of heights.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Louisiana"
programme.desc: Explosive demolition of the O. K. Allen Bridge.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Lewisham"
programme.desc: A council flat in Lewisham must come down quickly and without harming the local residents’ flats situated only metres away.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Paris"
programme.desc: Two high-rises in Meaux have to be demolished without endangering the surrounding people and buildings.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Belgium"
programme.desc: In this episode a 170 meter tower is imploded! The structure is close to a public highway so there’s an extra element of concern for local safety.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aviation 101"
programme.desc: An explanation of some of the very basics of aviation.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "ATC gibberish"
programme.desc: Breaking down and simplifying all that complex sounding radio chatter. Sara learns how to escape from a submerged aircraft and take to the air with a team of formation pilots flying WW2 era planes.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Can a kid land an airliner?"
programme.desc: A follow up to some of the popular sim segments from season one, but this time with a 12 year old at the controls! Kurtis shows us the many important functions of an often overlooked aspect of Air Traffic Control services and Anthony and Raeleen dig in at Greenville, SC.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Private pilot emergency"
programme.desc: Anthony closes the season 2 sim segments by having everything but the kitchen sink thrown at him. Can he do it? Spend the day at MCAS Miramar (formerly Top Gun), with US Marine fighter pilots at their legendary base.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Art of Shadowgraphy"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, the lights are off and the spotlight is on the art of shadowgraphy. Next up we’ll explore some card tricks and more optical illusions. Then feature rethinker performer Félicien Treway.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is moving pictures an illusion?"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, take a look at the shades of colour, explore the Body transfer illusion, Liars paradox and video. Is moving pictures an illusion?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is a telescope a time machine?"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Leidenfrost Effect"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s play games with colour changing milk. Learn about chroma keys in video editing and do some mental math gymnastics. We’ll also explore the Leidenfrost effect and take a look at rethinker Linwood G Dunn.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Saving the Iberian Lynx"
programme.desc: Reya El-Salahi visits Spain’s Sierra Morena to see how conservation brought the Iberian lynx back from under 100 to thriving again.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Imaging the Aurora"
programme.desc: Reya El-Salahi explores how the northern lights can disrupt technology and visits EISCAT 3D, a new radar studying solar particle impacts.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Crystal Cave"
programme.desc: A remarkable find was made in Chihuahua, Mexico, of a spectacular cave filled with giant crystals. George leads an Explorers Club Flag Expedition into the cave, wearing special refrigerated suits and respirators to battle the extreme environment

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "2009 Hurricane"
programme.desc: The “Angry Planet” team will be tracking storms through the 2009 Hurricane season, and plan to film george as he heads into a big one.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Turkmenistan"
programme.desc: The “Angry Planet” team hopes to film the natural wonders and extreme phenomena of this fascinating Central Asian country, including a spectacularly burning crater of natural gas, underground lakes, sandstorms and remnants of the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "The Ocean’s Apex"
programme.desc: In this episode, we observe two of the ocean’s apex predators in the wild.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Wind"
programme.desc: In this episode, Philippe takes us inside one of the most powerful forces on Earth - wind.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Student Explorer"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Iron Ore, Wave Flume, Chandeliers"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Oyster Knives, Stadium Lights, Diamonds"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Cheddar Cheese, CPR Mannequins, Dishwashers"
programme.desc: How do they make cheddar, the world's most popular cheese? How do they breathe life into Rususci Anne - the plastic woman that teaches CPR?

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Robot Revolution"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell gets introduced to a 200 pound robot that’s almost as graceful as a dancer.

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Nature’s games"
programme.desc: In this episode we learn about Carrion flowers, also called stink or corpse flower. The cuckoo hability to misdirect predators to find nests and how some animals released pheromones to comunicate.

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Perception"
programme.desc: Language plays a major role in how people from different parts of the world perceive color. Perspective Illusion is a technique used in illustrations to render scenes and objects in 3 dimensions with depth and

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Phantoms"
programme.desc: What is the Body Transfer Illusion or the Moon Illusion? We also explain how the Autokinetic Effect and the Stereoscopy work!

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "A Year of Space Odyssey"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the amazing journeys of spacecraft that gathered spectacular images of Mercury, Jupiter and Mars.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Paint Your Red River Stagecoach at High Noon"

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Taj Mahal And The Golden Age Of Islam"

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "How Gold Changed The World"

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Deadliest Weapons"
programme.desc: As the battle distance continued to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millenia to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Pop Sci Test"

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY Kickboxing’s Summer of GLORY concluded with a massive event from the Johan Cruijff Arena in Amsterdam. In the night’s headliner, heavyweight champion Rico Verhoeven took on Brazilian challenger Guto Inocente. Verhoeven had defended his belt seven straight times since capturing the title in 2014. His winning streak inside the GLORY ring stood at 16. Inocente looked to dethrone the world’s top-ranked heavyweight riding the momentum of wins over Benjamin Adegbuyi, D’Angelo Marshall and Hesdy Gerges. Gold was also on the line in the co-main event, as longtime featherweight titleholder Robin van Roosmalen rematched interim champion Petchpanomrung Kiatmookao. The pair met previously at GLORY 41 — also in van Roosmalen’s home country of Holland — with the Dutchman taking home a controversial, majority-decision victory.

programme.desc: GLORY is bringing out the heavy hitters for their final show of 2018, as an eight-man heavyweight tournament has been set for Rotterdam. programme.title: Jay Phillips Isn't Dead
programme.desc: The artistic and cinematic tale of Jay Phillips, one of Australia's greatest surfing talents.

programme.title: The Curious Tales of Italo Ferreira
programme.desc: He was the world's first Olympic surfing gold medalist. Can the Brazilian surfing sensation Ítalo Ferreira now wrap up the World Surf League Championship Tour title for the second successive time?

programme.title: Let's Be Frank
programme.desc: Is Frank Solomon a kind-hearted surfer or a hard-living bad boy? The man and myth may be inseparable.

programme.title: Bustin' Down The Door
programme.desc: This documentary explores how a group of surfers revolutionized surfing in 1975.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
